reasons.plausibility: The proposed Mo-doping mechanism and resulting phase transformations are scientifically coherent for CoCrFeNi-based alloys.
reasons.testability: They specify a clear sintering process and tribological testing protocol with a decisive comparison to baseline data.
reasons.usefulness: It does not address AlCrFeNiSi feedstock or residual stress issues in standard additive manufacturing, so it offers little direct relevance to the stated research question.
